keywords.name: Taunt
keywords.text: Enemy single-target attacks must hit this unit if they can reach it.

keywords.name: Barrier
keywords.text: Negates the next damage instance.

keywords.name: Tough
keywords.text: Takes X less damage per hit.

keywords.name: Lifesteal
keywords.text: Heals for the damage it deals.

keywords.name: Regenerate
keywords.text: Heals X at the start of each of its turns.

keywords.name: Overwhelm
keywords.text: Damage past the target's HP spills onto the unit behind.

keywords.name: Elusive
keywords.text: Only Ranged or Elusive units can target it.

keywords.name: Swift
keywords.text: Acts first.

keywords.name: Warcry
keywords.text: Fires at battle start.

keywords.name: Deathwish
keywords.text: Fires when this unit dies.

keywords.name: Bitemark
keywords.text: Fires each time this unit lands an attack.

keywords.name: Strikeback
keywords.text: When hit by melee, spends PP to hit back.

keywords.name: Ephemeral
keywords.text: Dies at the end of its turn (Ephemeral X: after X turns).

keywords.name: Summon
keywords.text: Puts a token in an empty cell; nothing if none is empty.

keywords.name: Transform
keywords.text: Turns into another form.

keywords.name: Solitary
keywords.text: Bonus while no ally is adjacent.

keywords.name: Anchor
keywords.text: Can't be moved by Push, Pull or Swap.

keywords.name: Push
keywords.text: Moves the target back a row, or deals X if it can't move.

keywords.name: Pull
keywords.text: Drags a back-row target to the front of its lane.

keywords.name: Swap
keywords.text: Trades places with an ally.

keywords.name: Dash
keywords.text: Moves one cell for free before attacking.

keywords.name: Blink
keywords.text: Moves to any empty cell on its side.

keywords.name: Icehold
keywords.text: Can't move or be moved.

keywords.name: Charge
keywords.text: +X damage on its first attack after moving this turn.

keywords.name: Zeal
keywords.text: Bonus while an ally is directly in front.

keywords.name: Guard
keywords.text: Takes a hit meant for an adjacent ally (1 PP).

keywords.name: Rally
keywords.text: All allies gain X for the fight.

keywords.name: Backstab
keywords.text: +X damage on targets that haven't acted this turn.

keywords.name: Vanish
keywords.text: After acting, Elusive until hit.

keywords.name: Combo
keywords.text: Each consecutive Songhai action gains +1 damage.

keywords.name: Vulnerable
keywords.text: Prime target for its next X hits taken; those hits deal bonus damage.

keywords.name: Haste
keywords.text: +X Speed.

keywords.name: Bounty
keywords.text: Earns X gold on kill.

keywords.name: Blast
keywords.text: Its attack hits the whole enemy row.

keywords.name: Purge
keywords.text: Removes an enemy's buffs.

keywords.name: Deathwatch
keywords.text: Fires whenever any unit dies.

keywords.name: Creep
keywords.text: Marks an enemy cell; its occupant takes X at turn start.

keywords.name: Souls
keywords.text: Gained on deaths, spent to empower actions (shared by the team).

keywords.name: Sacrifice
keywords.text: Kills an ally for value.

keywords.name: Curse
keywords.text: Loses X x 5% of its max HP at the end of each of its turns.

keywords.name: Weaken
keywords.text: Deals X less damage per hit.

keywords.name: Grow
keywords.text: +X Attack and HP at the start of each of its turns.

keywords.name: Frenzy
keywords.text: Attacks hit all adjacent enemies.

keywords.name: Rebirth
keywords.text: On death, leaves an Egg that hatches next turn unless killed. Once per fight.

keywords.name: Goad
keywords.text: One ally gains X for the fight.

keywords.name: Chill
keywords.text: -X Speed; at 3 stacks, Frozen (skips a turn).

keywords.name: Numb
keywords.text: Removes X AP or PP from an enemy.

keywords.name: Hush
keywords.text: Loses keywords and PP reactions for one turn.

keywords.name: Fearless
keywords.text: +1 Attack while in the front row.

keywords.name: Raid
keywords.text: Earns X gold when it survives the fight.

keywords.name: Rush
keywords.text: The effect is active during its first X turns, then ends.

keywords.name: Stall
keywords.text: The effect turns on after X of its turns and stays on.

keywords.text: Removes a harmful status from an ally.
